title: 容身
standfirst: 岩沿、栏杆、柱脚与树杈，各自留出一个位置。到了水上，身体只露出一小部分。
standfirstEn: A rock edge, railing, column and forked trunk each offer a place. On the water, only part of a body remains visible.
introduction: 两只小动物贴着岩石站住，白鸟的翅膀从栏杆上展开。靠近看，身体与承托它的地方接在一起：爪尖，树皮，柱脚的一小片阴影。
八幅照片从地面走向枝杈，最后停在水线。黑猫的身体拉成一道斜线，灰色的身体贴着树干收拢；水中的头部与尾缘，只露出各自的一段轮廓。身体嵌在原有的缝隙里，周围的地方仍然延续。
introductionEn: Two small animals stand close to a rock; white wings open above a railing. Seen nearby, bodies meet the places supporting them: claw tips, bark and a patch of shade beside a column.

Eight photographs move from ground to branches, then reach the waterline. A black cat forms a diagonal; a grey body gathers around a trunk. A head and a tail edge show only parts of what lies underwater. Bodies fit into existing spaces as the surroundings continue.

chapters.title: 贴地
chapters.text: 长尾横过落叶，黑猫的爪子停在白柱旁。身体摊开，地面没有因此退出画面。
chapters.textEn: A long tail crosses leaves; a cat’s paws stop beside a white column. Bodies spread out as the ground remains in view.

chapters.title: 枝杈
chapters.text: 树干分开又合拢，留下一处凹下的空位。前肢绕过树皮，身体在直线与弯曲之间找到位置。
chapters.textEn: Trunks diverge and meet, leaving a hollowed space. Forelimbs wrap around bark; bodies occupy the interval between straight and curved forms.

chapters.title: 水线
chapters.text: 头部露在圆纹前缘，尾鳍停在白色泡沫上方。水下的身体仍在，照片只留下它们越过水面的一小部分。
chapters.textEn: A head emerges at a ring of ripples; a tail fluke stands above white foam. Bodies remain underwater while the photographs retain only the parts crossing its surface.
